FAO-56 maximum effective rooting depth by production item.

Source: R/datasets_balances.R
fao56_root_depth.Rd

Ranges of maximum effective rooting depth Zr as printed in FAO-56 Table 22 (Allen, Pereira, Raes & Smith 1998, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8), mapped to WHEP production items. Footnote 1 of the table says that smaller values may be used for irrigation scheduling and larger ones for modelling soil water stress or rainfed conditions. Items without a row of their own in the table carry a stated proxy (method_root_depth "proxy"), and non-crop items (processed, animal, aggregate or non-plant products) have missing depths.

Usage

fao56_root_depth

Format

A tibble with columns:

item_prod_code

Production item code, as in items_prod_full.

fao56_crop

FAO-56 Table 22 crop name(s) the item maps to, separated by "; " when several rows are used; missing for non-crop items.

depth_min_m

Lower end of the Table 22 range, in metres; missing for non-crop items.

depth_max_m

Upper end of the Table 22 range, in metres; missing for non-crop items.

method_root_depth

How the item maps to Table 22: "direct" (one table row), "direct_multi" (several table rows), "proxy" (a stated substitute crop) or "none" (no root depth applies).

rationale

Why a proxy was chosen, or why no depth applies; missing for some direct matches.

source

Locator of the value in FAO-56 (Chapter 8, Table 22 and the section(s) of the table); missing when no depth applies.

Source

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D. & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Table 22. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm.

Examples

fao56_root_depth
#> # A tibble: 305 × 7
#>    item_prod_code fao56_crop depth_min_m depth_max_m method_root_depth rationale
#>             <dbl> <chr>            <dbl>       <dbl> <chr>             <chr>    
#>  1            809 Banana - …         0.5         0.9 proxy             abaca is…
#>  2            800 Sisal              0.5         1   proxy             agave fi…
#>  3            221 Almonds            1           2   direct            NA       
#>  4            711 Carrots            0.5         1   proxy             umbellif…
#>  5            515 Apples, C…         1           2   direct            pome fru…
#>  6            526 Apricots,…         1           2   direct            NA       
#>  7            226 Palm Trees         0.7         1.1 direct            generic …
#>  8            366 Artichokes         0.6         0.9 direct            NA       
#>  9            367 Asparagus          1.2         1.8 direct            NA       
#> 10            572 Avocado            0.5         1   direct            NA       
#> # ℹ 295 more rows
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: source <chr>
